purpose: Preflight for any registered clinical trial of myosin inhibitors (mavacamten, aficamten, MYK-581) in MYH7 / skeletal myopathy

queries.note: All 14 returned studies are keyword-match artifacts (myeloproliferative disease, trigger finger, inflammatory myopathies, Dupuytren's, adrenal insufficiency). None concern Laing distal myopathy or MYH7, and none use a myosin inhibitor.
NCT05099107 (COMPLETED) 'Changes of Motor Function Tests in Congenital Myopathy Subjects' uses Salbutamol, not a myosin inhibitor.

conclusion: As of 2026-10-16, ClinicalTrials.gov contains NO registered trial of a relaxed-state-stabilizing myosin inhibitor (mavacamten, aficamten, or MYK-581/MYK-224) for MYH7-related skeletal myopathy, Laing distal myopathy, or myosin storage myopathy. This is a genuine source-level absence relevant to the hypothesis status.
limitations: query.term uses loose keyword matching; a targeted advanced-search or EU-CTR/WHO-ICTRP cross-check was not performed. Labeled as a checked negative for ClinicalTrials.gov only.
